recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast close-up of a smiling male face with a sinister expression, rendered in a vibrant green hue with visible halftone dot patterns. The subject is framed by deep black hair that merges into a dark background, contrasted against a warm yellow-to-red gradient on the left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant green skin tone against deep black shadows
Warm gradient background contrasting with cool facial tones
Gothic lettering integrated into the upper left negative space
coreInvariants: Visible halftone dot screen across the face
Intense green color cast on skin
High-contrast lighting with deep black shadows in eyes and hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered face occupying 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and teeth, which provide the sharpest points of contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the grin, then up to the typography in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black hair on the right and top; a sliver of warm gradient on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant lime green for the facial highlights and midtones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for shadows, hair, and depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow-to-red gradient on the left margin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the green and gradient areas; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy stroke weight with thin connectors
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swash on the initial capital letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative typeface to maintain a gothic, theatrical mood.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the gothic, theatrical aesthetic of the original.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast close-up portrait of a man with a sinister grin. Apply a vibrant green color cast to the skin and a visible halftone dot pattern. The hair should be deep black and merge into the background. Add a vertical yellow-to-red gradient on the far left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add gothic blackletter text in the top left corner. The text should be black with a thin, vibrant green outer glow or outline.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible on the skin?
Is the skin tone a consistent vibrant green?
Is the typography a sharp, gothic blackletter?
Does the hair blend into a solid black background?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the green skin tone
Width of the left-side color gradient
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the halftone dots do not blur into a solid color.
Check that the green glow on the text matches the skin tone.
Verify the gradient on the left is distinct from the black background.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + Halftone screen + Monochromatic skin tint + Gothic display type + Edge gradient.
